title: Wands On
author: Wands On
description: Welcome to Wands On, a weekly Harry Potter podcast covering the latest news, theories, opinions and everything happening across the Wizarding World! 🪄⚡️ 🎙️ NEW episodes every Wednesday on all your favourite podcast platforms! Hosted by British Potterheads Zac & Todd — better known online as 'Zogwarts' & 'Shrewtl' — Wands On is your weekly dose of everything Harry Potter. Every week, Wands On will explore new lore, theories and debates that keep Potter fans talking. Expect controversial opinions, rankings, quizzes, deep dives, fan theories and plenty of magical nonsense along the way.
